command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 7` is relevant, but `grep -iA1` cannot collect 13 fields or distinguish multiple caches; unsafe SSH and suppressed errors further prevent auditable evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete Type 7 output for every cache before and after an approved reboot, map by handle plus socket/level/type, normalize size encodings and compare the complete field matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All 13 named fields, correctness, pre/post comparison, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a cache graph keyed by resolved CPU/socket association, level, type and handle, storing canonical byte sizes alongside raw legacy/extended encodings.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds hierarchy, stable identity and encoding-aware comparisons instead of a section-header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing/duplicate caches, wrong level/type/associativity, size overflow/decoder errors and reboot drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may reorder handles; stable matching must use semantic metadata and flag non-unique matches rather than forcing them.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define the expected cache population and whether exact handles or semantic topology are invariant; size comparison must preserve both encoded and canonical values.
expected_evidence: Legacy and Size2 encoded plus canonical sizes
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies Type 7 cache fields and reboot persistence; legacy and extended size fields are complementary version-dependent encodings.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The topology, mapping/unit policies, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; their absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents one truncated cache entry or string-formatted size from standing in for the full multi-record hierarchy and extended-size semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 7 usually contains multiple level/type records and two generations of size encoding. Correctness requires semantic mapping and canonical units while retaining raw encodings; otherwise reordered records or legacy overflow can produce false matches. The approved reboot dependency makes REQUIRES correct.
